criteria.name: Format and length
criteria.guidance: Clean, consistent layout that fits on one page. Clear section headings in a sensible order.

criteria.name: Contact details and links
criteria.guidance: Name, phone, college email, and working LinkedIn/GitHub/portfolio links. No broken or placeholder links.

criteria.name: Education
criteria.guidance: Degree, branch, college, graduation year and CGPA/percentage shown clearly; school marks if relevant.

criteria.name: Skills relevance
criteria.guidance: Skills match the roles a fresher applies for, are grouped sensibly, and are backed up by projects or experience.

criteria.name: Projects
criteria.guidance: Each project names the tech stack, what the student built, and the impact or result.

criteria.name: Action verbs and quantified results
criteria.guidance: Bullets start with strong action verbs and include numbers where possible (users, speed-up, accuracy, rank).

criteria.name: Grammar and consistency
criteria.guidance: No spelling or grammar mistakes; consistent tense, punctuation, date formats and capitalisation.
